 WGNO New Orleans Follow Road improvement project planned for North Broad Street
 Corbin Ross Fri, November 13, 2026 at 4:08 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. NEW ORLEANS ( WGNO ) — A town hall meeting was held to discuss a state-led road improvement project planned for North Broad Street on Thursday, Nov. 12.
 The project will repave North Broad Street, as well as add turning lanes and improved traffic signals. The Department of Transportation said the project will extend from Lafitte Avenue to France Road. It will be open to bidding next year.
  Burn ban extended in Washington Parish  
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Some attendees at the town hall expressed concerns about safety around the work site.
 "We have a high traffic of children going to school, seniors walking the street, going to Walgreens, they have to be able to access the local stores," said Richard Thomas, a local resident.
